messages.content:
Analyze the following resume text and extract structured information.
Return ONLY valid JSON with no markdown formatting.

Resume:
"""
Vikram Singh
Gurugram | vikram.devops@example.com

SUMMARY
Site reliability engineer who automates infrastructure and keeps production boring.

TECH STACK
K8s, Helm, ArgoCD, Terraform, Ansible, GCP, AWS, Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Linux, Bash, Python

EXPERIENCE
Senior SRE, Paytm (2021 - Present)
Migrated 120 microservices from VMs to GKE clusters with zero customer-facing downtime.
Wrote Terraform modules (IaC) for VPCs, Cloud SQL and IAM used by every platform team.
Introduced SLOs and error budgets; paging volume dropped by 45% in two quarters.
Led the incident review for a 2023 DNS outage and drove the fix to multi-region failover.

DevOps Engineer, HCL Technologies (2018 - 2021)
Built Jenkins CI pipelines and Ansible playbooks for 300 on-prem Linux servers.

EDUCATION
B.Tech Electronics and Communication, NIT Kurukshetra, 2018

CERTIFICATIONS
Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA)
Google Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer

"""

Return this exact JSON structure:
{
  "skills": ["skill1", "skill2", ...],
  "experience_summary": "A 2-3 sentence summary of their work experience",
  "projects": ["Project 1: brief description", ...],
  "education": "Degree, University, Year"
}

Rules:
- skills: extract ALL technical and soft skills mentioned
- experience_summary: summarize roles, companies, and years of experience
- projects: list each project with a one-line description
- education: most recent degree with institution
- If a section is not found, use empty string or empty array
